title: CVE-2026-13411 — Null condition in Playbooks import crashes the plugin
summary: Affected: Mattermost Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to validate null elements when decoding playbook import conditions which allows an authenticated attacker to crash the Playbooks plugin instance-wide via a crafted import request containing a null condition. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00709
